parsed.notes: The Senior Secured Net Leverage Ratio is negative (-0.09x) because senior secured net debt was $(19.6) million: cash exceeded the $45.0 million drawn on the Revolving Loan. The Total Net Leverage Ratio (1.77x) is defined in the Credit Agreement and disclosed in the covenant paragraph, but no limit is stated, so it may not be a maintenance covenant. The same figures are repeated in Note 5 and in MD&A. The company states it was in compliance with its covenants at September 30, 2026.
